# opnsense_ids_settings (Resource)

Singleton OPNsense Suricata IDS settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable intrusion detection. Defaults to `false`.
- `home_networks` (Set of String) Networks treated as local by Suricata. Defaults to an empty set.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces on which to inspect traffic. Defaults to an empty set.
- `mode` (String) Packet capture mode for intrusion detection. Defaults to `pcap`.
- `promiscuous` (Boolean) Whether to enable promiscuous mode. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton resource identifier.
